patthana15.35:1.1: sāsavañceva no ca āsavaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavo ceva na anāsavo na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana15.35:2.1: āsavañceva sāsavaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsave ceva na anāsavo ca na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
